counterfactual.change: changed initial.v from -0.4805 to 0.0, keeping all else identical. This removes initial kinetic momentum toward track end, allowing controller to keep cart within bounds without violating cart_in_track.

explanation: Shrunk scenario has initial x=-0.31 and initial v=-0.48 toward negative track end, no pushes, zero sensor noise. Controller applies only ~0.8-0.9 N positive (far below 41.4 N limit) – sufficient to keep pole upright (theta margin ~0.72 rad) but insufficient to reverse cart momentum before track end. Cart drifts monotically negative: at step 250 x=-2.207 (margin 0.19 m), at 260 x=-2.349 (margin 0.05 m), at 264 x=-2.408 violating |x|<=2.4. Cause is initial negative velocity combined with controller prioritizing pole angle over cart position recovery and limited effectiveness due to heavy pole (0.29 kg) and light cart.

violation.detail: cart at x=-2.409 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart drifts steadily to the left toward the track limit while the pole remains balanced upright. By step 264 it moves beyond the allowed track edge, causing the cart_in_track violation.
